title: "It's time. Have you booked yet?": the holiday booking nudge
summary: The holiday music is back, so remind people to book early. AI writes a short, friendly "it's time" nudge for your Reel and caption, with no fake urgency.
why: SocialPilot's Instagram Reels audio list, published October 30, 2026, says the most famous holiday pop song returns every November 1 with "it's time" memes. It names service businesses using it for booking pushes, like a salon asking "have you booked yet?", and lists another business posting "November bookings are open".
steps: Pick what people should book before the holidays: an appointment, a table, a class or a gift order.
Use the main prompt to write the on-screen lines and a caption.
Film one short clip: you or your space going from calm to festive, with the lines appearing in turn.
Add a holiday song from the app's own library and post it early in November.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: I run [type of business, for example a hair salon, barber, nail studio, restaurant or photography studio] in [town]. Write a short Instagram Reel for early November about booking before the holidays. Give me: 1) 4 on-screen lines, each under 8 words, starting with "It's time." and ending with "Have you booked yet?", 2) a caption under 60 words that says how to book: [online, phone, DM], 3) one line for the end screen. Friendly and festive, a little funny. Only use these real details: [your holiday hours or dates]. No fake countdowns, no "only 2 spots left", no made-up discounts.

prompts.label: Variation: "bookings are open" post
prompts.text: Write 3 short versions of a "Holiday bookings are open" post for my [business]. One cosy, one funny, one very short for a Story. Each under 40 words. Mention [what people can book] and [how to book]. Don't make up prices, numbers, reviews or deadlines I didn't give you.

prompts.label: Variation: friends and family
prompts.text: Write 5 funny "It's time." lines for a group chat or Reel reminding my friends and family to lock in holiday plans: who's hosting, the secret gift exchange date, the potluck list, the photo day. Each under 12 words. Warm and teasing, not bossy.

prompts.label: Variation: plan the clip
prompts.text: I want to film a 10-second Reel for my [business] that switches from normal to holiday mode on a beat, then shows a "Have you booked yet?" line. Give me a shot list of 3 to 4 quick shots I can film on my phone in 15 minutes in my [shop, studio or restaurant], plus where each line of text should appear.

tips: Be honest about availability. Say when you're really booking up, and never invent a countdown or "last spots".
Put how to book in the first line of the caption, so people don't have to hunt.
Use a holiday song from the app's library. Business accounts should use the commercial sound library so the post isn't muted.
Pin the post to your profile until mid-December so new visitors see it.
